laura: quick heads-up — sampleapp using mode: 'json' occasionally returns a string in res.parsed after an auth refresh.
rick: repro plz?
laura: minimal TS repro:
```ts
// ts
const r = await client.tool.call({ mode: 'json', input: { prompt: 'hey' } })
console.log(typeof r.parsed, r.parsed)
```
emily: logs?
laura: excerpt:
[2026-04-02T14:02:01Z] prepare -> {"prompt":"hey"}
[2026-04-02T14:02:01Z] send -> "{\"prompt\":\"hey\"}"
[2026-04-02T14:02:02Z] 401 -> refresh -> retry sends -> '"{\\"prompt\\":\\"hey\\"}"'
Error: unexpected token '"' at 0
rick: yup, double-encode in retry. temp mitigation: disable auto-retry for json-mode or patch auth middleware to skip stringify if typeof body === 'string'.
emily: also adding small defensive change in schema helper: if input is string, try JSON.parse before failing; reduces onboarding friction.
sdk-bot: created RW-2601: "json-mode auth-retry double-encode -> parsed string" assigned to @rick, labels: devex,p2
laura: will attach tiny ts/py sampleapp to RW-2601 and add a note in the onboarding guide. thanks!
